usage: Google Play promotional feature artwork; not gameplay footage

prompts.text:
Use case: ads-marketing; compositing/style-reference.
Create one finished Google Play feature graphic for the existing game Sugarfall, recomposing the provided game references into original promotional key art. Exact target canvas: 1024 pixels wide by 500 pixels high, landscape ratio 2.048:1, full bleed, opaque RGB. This is illustrated feature artwork, not a fake screenshot.
Input image 1 (game icon): reference for material rendering, appetizing food forms, mint/coral palette, and lighting; do not repeat its giant isolated donut composition.
Input images 2,3,4 (actual game screens): references for the three area's pale mint ceramic, lavender gelato marble, pale aqua crystal glass, warm copper rims, cream labels, and round cookie/waffle/candy pegs. Do not copy their buttons, menus, numbers, or UI.
Composition: a unified shallow three-quarter view of a decorative ceramic peg board across the lower and right two-thirds. On the board, a pink-frosted donut ball visibly bounces past round biscuit pegs; a small pink gelato scoop arcs past waffle pegs; one luminous turquoise candy ball ricochets among amber candy pegs. These are the three current game themes, shown together only as promotional illustration. Their forms must read at small size, with a few clear contact sparks/crumbs and restrained curved motion trails. No characters, faces, hands, knives, factories, machines, casino symbols, game controllers or unrelated food.
The left-central upper portion has large, highly readable game title text exactly "Sugarfall", in warm cream with a fine copper edge, sturdy rounded editorial serif lettering that matches the game's premium ceramic bakery UI. One line, correctly spelled, generous breathing room. No subtitle or tagline. Key title and main action entirely within the central safe area, away from all four edges. Decorative edges may have soft ceramic tile and tiny crumbs only.
Style: polished tactile 3D game illustration, soft directional daylight, clean specular copper and sugar-glaze highlights, visible crumb texture, clear silhouettes; refined rather than childish. Background gradients subtly transition mint to lavender and pale aqua. Avoid dark ominous colors, pure white empty background, photoreal food advertising, excessive tiny details, busy scatter, giant icon duplication, price/ranking claims, store badges, watermarks or any extra text.
The artwork must represent aiming balls at pegs, not baking/restaurant-management gameplay. Please deliver the precise 1024x500 opaque raster feature graphic.

Refine this Sugarfall Google Play feature graphic. Preserve all artwork, colors, lighting, materials, three ball types and peg-board composition. Change only the title placement and size: move the complete Sugarfall wordmark slightly right, and reduce it about12 percent, so its leftmost visible pixel begins at least13 percent of the full canvas width from the left edge; keep its rightmost pixel at or before60 percent of the canvas width. Keep at least12 percent canvas-height margin above the title. It must remain a single correctly spelled word, warm cream with copper outline, clearly legible at thumbnail size. This gives the title room for Google's crops. No other text, badges or changes. Opaque full-bleed landscape. Target exact Google Play export1024x500 pixels; retain a near2.048:1 composition.

technical_export: Godot Image resize with preserved aspect ratio, six-pixel top/bottom center crop after resampling; RGB24 feature and RGBA32 icon. Existing icon artwork retained.
